stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Welcome to Wagga Wagga Country Club, Damien Widdison - great to have Wauchope GC with us today. Enjoy your round.

stories.title: Away-Day Raid
stories.detail: Visitor from Moore Park GC sitting 3rd - raiding the local silverware

stories.title: Speed Bump
stories.detail: nett birdie on hole 4, blow-up on hole 5 - the course corrects

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 3 pars in a row on holes 10, 11 & 12 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 3 pars on the bounce on holes 10, 11 & 12

stories.title: Giveth and Taketh Away
stories.detail: nett birdie straight into a bogey on holes 1 & 2

stories.title: Three Over, Moving On
stories.detail: +3 on hole 3 - a moment of golf we shall never speak of again

stories.title: Bogey Parade
stories.detail: 3 in a row on holes 3, 4 & 5 - sticking to the bogey script

stories.title: Plot Hole
stories.detail: 2 blow-ups on holes 4 & 5 - the scorecard disagrees with the player
